study type: Experimental animal study (toxicology study in pregnant rats)
exposure: Dry extract of Justicia pectoralis at doses of 300, 600, or 1200 mg/kg
outcome: Histopathological analysis of maternal organs (liver, kidneys, uterus, ovaries)
cohort: Pregnant Wistar rats (n = 10 per group) treated from gestational day (GD) 0-20.
finding: Oral administration of J. pectoralis dry extract during pregnancy did not induce maternal toxicity, embryotoxic, or teratogenic effects in Wistar rats.
